name: Minuscule Great Adventure
description: Embark on a minuscule great adventure that packs over half the troubles in the cosmos! Assemble your hero squad, challenge stage after stage of trials, and defeat all the formidable foes in your path.
introduction:
◆ Introduction ◆
● Embark on a minuscule great adventure and defeat all formidable foes.

◆ Event Rules ◆
● In "Minuscule Great Adventure," the Trailblazer will enter a minuscule world and head to different planets to challenge formidable foes. On each planet, the Trailblazer must simultaneously dispatch 4 teams to tackle 4 independent routes. Configuring your teams based on each route's exclusive buffs and enemy traits is the key to an easy victory!

◆ Limited-Time Rewards ◆
● During the limited-time event, completing specified missions will earn you corresponding rewards.
